evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/IdentityServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:90 calls services.AddAuthorization() with no FallbackPolicy

findings.recommendation: Each new endpoint must call .RequireAuthorization() and each new page must gate with getSession(), with anonymous-rejection tests. findings.title: Accounts and every identity table are global, not tenant-owned; GOZ-0003 prompt wrongly expects GOZ-0001 tenant tables to retrofit
evidence: docs/specs/001-local-identity/spec.md FR-034; data-model.md: nothing is tenant-owned
tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/BootstrapBoundaryTests.cs:41-47: schema holds exactly auth_sessions,data_protection_keys,user_claims,user_logins,user_tokens,users
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/DbTicketStore.cs:17-21,101-103 and SessionPrincipalValidator.cs:21-23 resolve sessions through IDbContextFactory before any tenant context exists
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/OperatorCommands.cs:43-44 runs operator commands as gozleme_app without HTTP
docs/prompts/spec-0003.md GOZ-0000-IF-03 bullet: 'Retrofit RLS onto the tenant-owned tables introduced by GOZ-0001 and GOZ-0002'
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0003 puts the six identity tables on an explicit non-tenant allow-list in the RLS catalog test. Tenant context is SET LOCAL only, is never required for identity lookups, and never leaks across pooled connections (needs a test). GOZ-0002 references users(id) by foreign key and adds no tenant column to users.

findings.title: Session-ticket claims are frozen at sign-in; only the security stamp is re-validated, and rotating it signs the account out everywhere
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/DbTicketStore.cs:34-58 serializes the ticket once into auth_sessions; RenewAsync :62-75 re-protects the same principal
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/SessionPrincipalValidator.cs:21-27 compares only the stamp claim against the database
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/SessionRevoker.cs:10-14 deletes every session row and calls UpdateSecurityStampAsync
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/IdentityServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:38-54 AddIdentityCore registers no roles
findings.recommendation: Membership, active organization, roles and policy subject are resolved from the database per request and never trusted from claims. Membership and role changes do not rotate the stamp. Epochs (GOZ-0023) and session revocation remain distinct, and account-level revocation also invalidates principal-bound receipts.

findings.title: Emails are unverified and self-registration is open by default, so email cannot establish identity for invitations, namespaces, SoD or account linking
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/IdentityServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:51 RequireConfirmedEmail = false; AuthEndpoints.cs:86 creates accounts with an unconfirmed email
src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/AuthOptions.cs:11 RegistrationEnabled defaults to true; compose.yaml:55; deploy/helm/gozleme/values.yaml:27
docs/specs/001-local-identity/contracts/auth-api.openapi.yaml:40 emailVerified const false
research.md R7 accepts a residual 409 duplicate-registration signal
docs/prompts/spec-0002.md scope: 'invitation or controlled local add'
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0002 accepts invitations by a single-use secret or by controlled local add, never by email match, and never reveals account existence. GOZ-0005 derives no namespace from email domains. GOZ-0021 claims only account-level separation of duties and grants nothing to new self-registered accounts. GOZ-0004 adds no HTTP reset or unlock.

findings.title: Backup and restore can resurrect revoked sessions, and backups contain the unencrypted key ring
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/SessionRevoker.cs:12 and DbTicketStore.cs:127-137 revoke only by deleting rows
docs/specs/001-local-identity/research.md R3 and deploy/helm/gozleme/README.md: the Data Protection key XML is unencrypted at rest, so read access allows forging cookies
data_protection_keys and auth_sessions live in the same gozleme schema as all application data
findings.recommendation: The GOZ-0039 restore invalidates all sessions (truncate auth_sessions and rotate stamps or the key ring), tests that a cookie from before the backup is rejected after restore, and treats backups as credential material. GOZ-0035 includes sessions and the key ring in its retention inventory.

findings.recommendation: GOZ-0029 designs peer authentication and exposure, never accepts user session cookies from peers, decides forwarded-header trust and rate limits, and preserves invariant 10. Later federation specs reuse it.

findings.title: Rate-limiting infrastructure covers only credential endpoints, is per instance, and keys on a spoofable address
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Identity/IdentityServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:111-137 defines a single GlobalLimiter partitioned only for sign-in and register, plus named policies

findings.recommendation: Expensive endpoints add named per-client policies and extend the GlobalLimiter partitioning rather than replacing it. No security decision is keyed on client address.

findings.title: Fail-closed database-outage handling is global and is inherited by new endpoints
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/GozlemeApp.cs:52 UseDatabaseUnavailableResponses runs before authentication

tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/DatabaseOutageTests.cs:34-70
findings.recommendation: Endpoint code does not swallow Npgsql connection failures. Streaming responses that have already started cannot be converted to 503, so they must handle mid-stream failure explicitly.
